business: SEGMENT: personal injury law, Kansas City
prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Kansas City after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Kansas City Missouri for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — first a couple quick questions so I give you the best, targeted recommendations:

1. Do you mean Kansas City, Missouri (KCMO) or Kansas City, Kansas (KCK)? (The right firms and the statute of limitations differ by state.)  
2. Were you injured and do you need medical care now?  
3. Do you know if you were at fault or if the other driver was at fault?  
4. Do you prefer a local boutique trial firm or a larger regional/national plaintiff firm?

If you want recommendations right away without answering those, I can still give a short list of what to look for and how to pick a firm plus questions to ask on the initial call. Here are those items now so you can act immediately:

Which firms to call (how I’ll pick them for you)
- I’ll prioritize plaintiff-side personal injury firms that handle car crashes, have trial experience, work on contingency (no fee unless they recover), and show a record of settlements/verdicts in auto cases. I’ll include at least one local boutique trial firm and one larger/national firm with a local presence.

What to ask when you call (short checklist)
- Do you handle car-accident personal injury cases? (Not insurance defense.)
- How long have you handled these cases in Kansas/Missouri?
- What is your typical case load and who will actually handle my case (attorney vs. paralegal)?
- Do you work on contingency? What is your fee and costs policy?
- Have you taken similar cases to trial? Any recent settlements/verdicts?
- What’s your estimate of next steps and timeline?
- Can I get a free consultation and do you offer a written retainer?

What to bring to the first consult or have ready
- Photos of the crash scene and vehicles, police report number, drivers’ and witnesses’ names, insurance information, medical records/ bills, timeline of events, and any communication with insurers.

Immediate steps (if you haven’t already)
- Get medical treatment and keep records.  
- Preserve evidence: photos, dashcam, app data, damage.  
- Report the crash to police and your insurer as required.  
- Don’t give a recorded statement to the other side’s insurer without a lawyer.  
- Note the statute of limitations: Missouri personal injury claims generally have up to 5 years; Kansas generally 2 years — I can confirm your deadline if you tell me which state.

If you’d like, tell me MO or KS and a bit about injuries/fault and I’ll return a targeted list of 6–8 specific Kansas City firms (with brief reasons to call each and typical contact steps). Which city/state should I use?
